svg.title: 10 chatbot architecture pipeline
svg.desc: Conceptual chatbot pipeline linked to architecture tiers 1 (browser), 2 (PHP) and 3 (ArcadeDB). Two left-to-right rows show the main path. Clarification revises input; unsupported paths/no records yield explicit responses. Structured context is revalidated for fresh KG retrieval. Optional model assistance uses validated facts for language only; results/citations are constructed deterministically. Failure and optional branches are schematic, not exhaustive control flow or timing measurements.
